label_origin: team judgement from report text; draft by assistant, pending review
trl_rationale: Algorithm integrated on a B-787 flight test aircraft and flown in five flight trials in real-world operations.

evidence.quote: The implementation of the NASA ASTAR algorithm aboard a B787 flight test aircraft proved successful in real world operations.
The ASTAR algorithm was integrated with the Boeing supplied B-787 ecoDemonstrator aircraft
Initial results indicated arrival times within several seconds of accuracy of the planned termination point between two aircraft performing FIM in a real world environment.

review_notes: Trap: title says 'Proof-of-Concept' but this is a flight test. TRL 6 is arguable given only one day of trials.
